messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — BlueWave asked us to coordinate a joint marketplace + press for a sovereign region add (eu-central-2). We need marketplace quota approval, KMS/HSM entitlements, and SI integration signoff. Target launch window: next sprint (2 weeks). Anyone blocking?

aj-eng: Thanks. Do we have confirmed SKU/capacity numbers from BlueWave? need GPU SKU list + expected steady qps.

maria-partnerships: BlueWave sent an initial ask: 6x A10G + 2x H100 reserved, plus burst headroom. Link to their spreadsheet: https://bluewave.example/region-euc2-capacity (internal).

liam-cloud: Submitted marketplace quota request to Azure yesterday. Request ID: Q-782131. ETA from infra quota team is 5–7 business days. I attached the request payload in comments.

aj-eng: Cool. Can we already pre-authorize fallback SKUs? If H100 not available we should route to A10G pool with perf profile. Need entitlements to include both SKU families.

maria-partnerships: Good call. BlueWave is fine with fallback plan. We should add a routing policy in the deployment config.

deepa-solutions: On the SI side: partner's onboarding checklist flagged two items: VPC peering + private DNS forwarding, and a cert rotation flow with their HSM. Also need to confirm the SI's support window aligns with our SLA.

sarah-legal: For the joint announcement — we need an embargo date and a short legal review. Please upload the draft announcement to the shared drive. Also confirm that the customer data path stays inside the sovereign region for compliance (they requested that).

maria-partnerships: Draft is in drive: https://drive.redwood/teams/partnerships/bluewave-euc2-draft.md — please add comments. Proposed embargo: 2025-05-12 15:00 UTC.

ops-bot: [quota-bot] Quota ticket Q-782131 status: PENDING_REVIEW by Azure Marketplace Team. No blockers reported.

liam-cloud: Azure asked for KMS proof-of-control. We need to show KMS integration diagram + key usage policy. Can someone upload the diagram?

aj-eng: I'll paste the minimal diagram here:
```
Redwood VPC -> Private Endpoint -> BlueWave Marketplace Gateway -> Customer VNet (eu-central-2)
KMS: Redwood KMS (customer keys) via HSM proxy + Azure KeyVault integration
```

deepa-solutions: SI note: their onboarding templates expect handshake endpoint at /si/onboard with mTLS. We'll need a cert signed by our CA and rotate cadence.

maria-partnerships: Action list: 1) aj-eng: add fallback SKU routing & deployment config (owner) — due EOD tomorrow. 2) liam-cloud: push KMS diagram + KMS proof to quota ticket — due today. 3) deepa-solutions: validate SI handshake + rotation plan with BlueWave — due in 48h. 4) sarah-legal: sign off embargo + legal review — due in 72h.

aj-eng: on it. will open a PR against infra-config with the routing policy and quantized perf profile.

liam-cloud: uploaded KMS diagram and policy to ticket Q-782131 (comment id 44).

deepa-solutions: scheduled quick call with BlueWave SI lead for tomorrow 10:30am UTC. invite sent.

sarah-legal: reviewing draft now; will add redlines by EOD.

maria-partnerships: Thanks all. If Azure approves quota this week we can lock the go/no-go on Friday. Please ping here with updates. :thumbsup:

aj-eng: ping — PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/region-routing/pulls/122 — includes `fallback_skus` and `canary_policy`.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Reminder: preflight checklist for new region must pass: network, quotas, KMS, SI, billing. Use /region-preflight to kick off once items are green.

liam-cloud: Azure updated Q-782131 -> APPROVED_FOR_LIMIT_INCREASE. Still pending legal/KMS confirmation.

maria-partnerships: Perfect. I'll coordinate press timeline after legal sign-off.

sarah-legal: Signed off on embargo + basic T&Cs. One ask: add explicit clause about data residency for sovereign customers. Added to the draft.

deepa-solutions: SI integration checklist is green except rotation automation. BlueWave agreed to provide a webhook for rotation events. we can automate.

maria-partnerships: Closing loop: quota approved, legal + SI mostly green, PR open for routing. Targeting Friday go/no-go call at 16:00 UTC. I'll create the calendar invite. :calendar:

aj-eng: will validate canary today and update PR with canary metrics.

liam-cloud: thumbs up. I'll monitor quota and KMS audit logs during the rollout.

maria-partnerships: Great teamwork. If anyone hits a blocker, escalate to @exec on this thread.

ops-bot: [incident-bot] Note: no incidents currently linked to this region.
